title: [finding] `POST /api/v1/datasources` (and the PATCH door) never run `DatasourceSchema`'s cross-field refinements — a mongo `credentialsRef` pairing that `os build` and `PUT /meta` refuse is accepted 201, and the bound secret is silently unused
body:
Filing gate: **① a reproducible product defect with a named landing site** — `packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-service.ts`. `reach:` the public REST admin door, reproduced on four fresh showcase boots (runner + independent verifier). Reader: triage first touch, then the lane owning `service-datasource`. Dedupe: semantic search "datasource admin createDatasource assertValidConfig credentialsRef mongo pairing refinement skipped" (open + closed) → 14 hits, none this defect; nearest is #7744 (closed: an unknown-driver draft accepted 201). QA-source: #21056 · integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix · negative[1] ## What happens The same datasource is refused at two doors and accepted at the third. No credential is exposed; the defect is that the admin door accepts a pairing that cannot work as written — the bound secret is never used, the datasource connects anonymously, and nothing tells the operator. ## Reproduction 1. Fresh boot: `OS_PORT=

pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --seed-admin -p

-d file:.db`; admin bearer from `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email`. No mongo server is needed — this is authoring-time validation. 2. `POST /api/v1/datasources {"name":"r19b_mg_nouser","driver":"mongodb","config":{"url":"mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/qa"},"secret":"any-secret"}` → **201** (`status:"error"` only because the pool cannot connect). `GET /api/v1/datasources/r19b_mg_nouser` → 200 `hasSecret:true`. 3. `GET /api/v1/meta/datasource/r19b_mg_nouser` → `_diagnostics.valid:false`, "this mongo `config.url` names no user in its userinfo while `external.credentialsRef` binds a secret — a pair that cannot work as written". 4. Composed variant `{"config":{"host":"127.0.0.1","database":"qa"},"secret":"any"}` → 201; meta read `valid:false` at `config.username`. 5. Controls: the same pairing through `PUT /api/v1/meta/datasource/` with `external.credentialsRef` → 422 INVALID_METADATA; with `mongodb://app@…` → 200. `objectstack build` of a stack declaring it → exit 2 "Validation failed". An inline password in the url IS refused by the admin door (400), so per-config checks run there — only the cross-field ones do not. ## Mechanism - `datasource-admin-service.ts` `createDatasource` → `assertValidConfig(driver, config)` → `validateDriverConfig` (`packages/spec/src/data/driver/config-registry.zod.ts`), which sees `config` only. `external.credentialsRef` is attached afterwards from `writeSecret`, and the record is persisted with `putDatasourceRecord` — no `DatasourceSchema` parse ever runs. `updateDatasource` has the same gap. - So the whole `DatasourceSchema.superRefine` in `packages/spec/src/data/datasource.zod.ts` is skipped on this door — the mongo pairing refinements (`CREDENTIALS_REF_MONGO_URL_NO_USER_REFUSED`, its composed twin) and others: `schemaMode: 'external'` with no `external` block is also accepted 201 and reads back `valid:false`. - `assertValidConfig`'s own docstring says this door exists to prevent "the same silent acceptance, one door along". ## Landing site and acceptance - In `createDatasource` / `updateDatasource` (and arguably `testConnection`), judge the record as it will be persisted — including the `credentialsRef` that `secret` or the existing binding supplies — against `DatasourceSchema`'s cross-field refinements before `writeSecret` / `putDatasourceRecord`. Ideally `datasource.zod.ts` exports those refinements as a reusable check, as `validateDriverConfig` is exported. - Done when steps 2 and 4 answer 400 with the build door's message, nothing persists, and `integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix` negative[1] re-runs green. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
